commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' 1 - 3 What bad luck! Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:3.
90+1' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kirian Rodriguez walks off.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Scott McKenna (Las Palmas).
86' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.

86' A pass travels right across the box to Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla denies him with a decent save.
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Las Palmas was in an offside position.
82' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
81' Rayo Vallecano quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
79' That will be all from Fabio Silva who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
79' Dario Essugo goes off the pitch and Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) for Isi Palazon.
77' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pep Chavarria.
77' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.

76' Jasper Cillessen pulls off a great save to deny Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
74' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

73' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.

71' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Aridane Hernandez and he is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
71' Here's the change. Gerard Gumbau leaves the pitch and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
70' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
66' 0 - 3 Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
64' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
64' The substitution has been made. Manuel Fuster has replaced Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas).
62' 0 - 2 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano), who heads the corner kick behind his own keeper. The score is 0:2.
62' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is about to take a corner kick.

62' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

57' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
55' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

53' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.

45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

44' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak shot that heads towards the left post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
42' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) makes a strong challenge and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
39' The corner kick picks out Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
38' Corner kick. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to send the ball into the box.

37' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.

33' What a big chance! Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
31' The free kick from long range, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano get a free kick.
29' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Francisco Maeso stops the game and makes a call.
28' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

28' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Las Palmas.
26' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Rough tackle by Alex Munoz (Las Palmas). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
21' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play.
18' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
16' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
14' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

14' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.
13' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
13' Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) takes the free kick, but it sails wide of the target. The goalkeeper didn't have to react at all.
10' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.

7' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

6' 0 - 1 Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
5' Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
